    Preliminaries for Bongartz's Lemma 2.4 (b) #

    Left almost split maps under isomorphisms; modules whose decomposition summands live on T' live on T'; restriction preserves isomorphism and exactness; and a left almost split map over the quotient restricts to a left almost split map over A as soon as some left almost split map over A with the same source lands in modules living on T' (isLeftAS_res).
